Here's my summary of work so far:

## Completed So Far

### R1 - 'l' (letters) format specifier
- Added 'l' to `ALLOWED_TYPES` set (line ~642)
- Added regex pattern `[a-zA-Z]+` for type 'l' in `_handle_field` method (~line 995 area)

### R2 - `__contains__` method on Result
- Added `__contains__(self, item)` method to Result class that checks if item exists in either `fixed` tuple or `named` dict values

### R10 - Slice access on Result
- Modified `__getitem__(self, item)` in Result class to handle slices: returns a new Result with sliced `fixed` tuple and sliced `named` dict
- Added helper `_slice_named(slc)` method

### R3 - Brace validation
- Added `_validate_braces(format)` method to Parser.__init__ that validates all braces are properly matched and enclosed
- Raises ValueError if unmatched opening/closing braces found

## Still Pending

### R4 - FixedTzOffset timezone offset parsing (Bug 92)
- Need to investigate the issue with negative offsets or sign handling in date_convert and FixedTzOffset

### R5 - Fortran-formatted floats
- Need to add support for Fortran-style exponents like `1D+10`, `1d+10` in float patterns (currently only handles e/E)

### R6 - Hex/binary/octal with base arguments & auto-detection
- May need improvements to int_convert and regex patterns for b, o, x types

### R7 - Pickle compatibility (functors instead of lambdas)
- Lines ~984-994 have lambda functions for f, F, e, g type conversions
- Line ~959 has inner function `f` for extra_types
- Need to replace these with callable classes

### R8 - findall respects case_sensitive
- Line ~1276: `findall()` creates second Parser without `case_sensitive`: `Parser(format, extra_types=extra_types).findall(...)`
- Needs to pass `case_sensitive=case_sensitive`

### R9 - Left/center-aligned search consumes up to next space
- Current alignment logic uses fill character repetition (`fill*`)
- For search mode ('<', '^'), need to stop at whitespace boundary

## Files to Modify
- Only `parse.py` (no test file modifications allowed)

## Test Status
- All 74 existing tests pass with Python 3.12
